rows.challenge: One shared token and every tool exposed to every caller: no attribution, no per-tool control, so security stalls adoption.
rows.technical: Per-user identity, per-tool policy and injected credentials on every call, fully audited.
rows.business: MCP integrations proceed under existing governance; faster time to value on agent projects.

rows.challenge: Each agent-server pair needs its own connection, config and credential, so effort and attack surface grow with each pair.
rows.technical: One connection, one policy cap enforced twice, one audit trail across members.
rows.business: New servers join by configuration, not project work: lower per-integration cost, faster rollout.
